  a = c("null", 33, 33, "null", "null", "null"),
  b = c(28, 55, 43, 91, 81, 53),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE

# Generated by vl2ggplot::vegalite_to_ggplot(spec, chart_var = "chart", ignore_unsupported = FALSE, include_source_paths = FALSE)
library(ggplot2)

chart_data <- data.frame(
  x = c(0.01, 0.1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 10, 10, 100, 500, 800),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)
chart_data <- dplyr::mutate(chart_data, log_x = log(x)/log(10))
chart_data <- dplyr::mutate(chart_data, .brks = list(pretty(log_x, 20)))
chart_data <- dplyr::mutate(chart_data, bin_log_x = .brks[[1]][findInterval(log_x, .brks[[1]], all.inside = TRUE)], bin_log_x_end = .brks[[1]][findInterval(log_x, .brks[[1]], all.inside = TRUE) + 1], .brks = NULL)
chart_data <- dplyr::mutate(chart_data, x1 = (10)^(bin_log_x))
chart_data <- dplyr::mutate(chart_data, x2 = (10)^(bin_log_x_end))
chart <- ggplot2::ggplot(chart_data)
chart <- chart + ggplot2::geom_rect(
  mapping = ggplot2::aes(
  xmin = ((x1) + ((x2) - (x1)) / 2) - ((((x2) - (x1)) / 2) * 0.9),
  xmax = ((x1) + ((x2) - (x1)) / 2) + ((((x2) - (x1)) / 2) * 0.9)
),
  stat = "count",
  ymin = -0.5,
  ymax = 0.5
) + ggplot2::theme(axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_blank())

# Generated by vl2ggplot::vegalite_to_ggplot(spec, chart_var = "chart", ignore_unsupported = FALSE, include_source_paths = FALSE)
library(ggplot2)

chart_data <- data.frame(
  country = c("Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States"),
  animal = c("pigs", "pigs", "cattle", "cattle", "cattle", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "pigs", "pigs", "pigs", "pigs", "pigs", "pigs", "cattle", "cattle", "cattle", "cattle", "cattle", "cattle", "cattle", "cattle", "cattle", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)
chart_data <- dplyr::mutate(chart_data, emoji = {'cattle': '🐄', 'pigs': '🐖', 'sheep': '🐏'}[animal])
chart_data <- dplyr::group_by(chart_data, country, animal)
chart_data <- dplyr::mutate(chart_data, .win_rn = dplyr::row_number(), .win_tie = dplyr::consecutive_id(dplyr::row_number()))
chart_data <- dplyr::group_by(chart_data, country, animal, .win_tie)
chart_data <- dplyr::mutate(chart_data, .win_rank = min(.win_rn))
chart_data <- dplyr::group_by(chart_data, country, animal)
chart_data <- dplyr::mutate(chart_data, rank = .win_rank)
chart_data <- dplyr::select(chart_data, -.win_rn, -.win_tie)
chart_data <- dplyr::ungroup(chart_data)
chart <- ggplot2::ggplot(chart_data)
chart <- chart + ggplot2::geom_text(
  mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = factor(rank), y = factor(animal), label = factor(emoji)),
  size = 65
)
# NOTE: width/height are set when saving/displaying, e.g. ggsave(..., width = 800, height = 200)
chart <- chart + ggplot2::facet_grid(rows = dplyr::vars(country))


chart
